detailPracticeText: Practice in simulated chats, documents, boards, and calendars. Every tool action leaves evidence you can inspect.
detailPrivateText: Invite people by account or temporary password. Teams can view shared work live; admins can turn sharing off at any time.
detailShowcaseText: Compare prompts and outcomes together. Hosts control timing, attendance, visibility, and when work becomes read-only.
detailTakeawayText: Turn your instructions into readable Markdown skills. Export one skill or split a larger workflow into focused skills.
draftNotice: Draft changes are local until you save them.
error: Something didn’t work. Please try again.
facilitatorIntro: No code to write. No real accounts to connect. Just your team, a shared challenge, and room to experiment.
facilitatorTitle: A workshop everyone can take part in.
feedbackHelp: Share a suggestion with the community or open a GitHub issue. You can review your message before submitting.
guestHelp: Generate a random password. Rotating it removes existing password-only guests. Passwords are shown only once.
intro: A place for your team to learn AI by doing. Shape an agent, put it to work in a safe sandbox, and discover what makes great instructions.
inviteHelp: Use your invited Tuturuuu account or a temporary room password from your host.
inviteNotice: Account access is granted here. Share the room link yourself; no email is sent.
joinTeamHelp: Your host can move you to another team after joining.
limitHint: Room AI budget: 200 operations. Each agent run has at most 6 actions. Coaching is AI-generated and may be mistaken.
lobbyDescription: Build better AI teammates, together. Join an invited room or host a practice session.
multiple: Split into focused skills when useful
name: Your display name
newer: A teammate saved a newer version. Copy your work before loading theirs.
preferencesHelp: Manage your Colab preferences. Your profile and accounts are managed on Tuturuuu.
previewDisclaimer: Illustrative example · no AI call or account needed
previewEyebrow: A SMALL CHANGE. A BETTER TEAMMATE.
previewIntro: Try two instructions for the same task. Notice what the agent checks, what it assumes, and when it asks.
promptHelp: Describe its role, the steps it should follow, when it should ask a question, and what it must never do.
readOnlyHelp: The room is not accepting edits. You can review the work you have access to.
refinedPrompt: Read the launch brief. Check everyone’s calendar before suggesting a time. Draft an invitation, then ask our team to approve it before sending.
refinedResult: “I found a shared opening and drafted the invite. Would you like to approve it?”
remoteWork: This team’s work is available for review.
roughPrompt: Help our team organize the product launch.
roughResult: The agent has a goal, but no guidance about scheduling conflicts or who approves the invitation.
runsEmpty: Your first experiment starts here. Generate a skill, then test your agent.
sandboxHelp: All records and actions stay inside this workshop. No real messages, calendars, or files are changed.
saveBefore: Save your prompt before generating skills.
scheduleHelp: 5 minutes to 8 hours. Up to 100 people across 12 teams, including admins.
showcaseOff: Your work is private to your team and admins
skillsEmpty: Your instructions become readable SKILL.md files here.
starterText: You are our careful launch coordinator. Read the launch brief and relevant team discussions before making claims. Cite the records you used. If information conflicts or is missing, ask a clear question. Draft updates in the requested language. Ask for approval before publishing or changing records. Never invent a date or share private information.
steerPlaceholder: For example: a bilingual launch update with conflicting dates and a missing approval…
step1Text: Write what a helpful teammate should do, in your own words.
step2Text: Explore realistic tasks across familiar, fully simulated apps.
step3Text: Compare approaches, refine your skills, and take them with you.
